title: The FNOL intake batch dies after the JDK 21 release
scenario: claimdesk-intake 4.13.0 moved to JDK 21 and added schema v3 events. Every night since, it parses one file and dies with NoSuchMethodError. CI was green, on-call blames JDK 21 and has drafted a rollback that would undo the schema reserving now depends on.
task: Find what is on the runtime classpath, why Maven chose it, and why CI did not catch it
Rule JDK 21 in or out with evidence
Fix pom.xml so all Jackson artifacts converge while keeping the SEC-2291 floor
Add an enforcer rule that would have failed the 4.13.0 build
acceptance: The batch processes the whole inbox; events and audit fingerprints are correct
jackson-core, databind and jsr310 are the same version at runtime
An upper-bound or convergence rule is in the build; the stale pin is gone
ANSWER.md names the dependencyManagement mechanism with tree and log evidence

practices.label: Week 1 Thu - Maven mediation, BOMs and enforcer rules
